verdict.rationale: Pinecone's homepage says users can manage indexes from the console 'or stay in the terminal,' which points to first-party terminal management but never names or documents an official CLI. The Claude Code plugin install and the Gemini CLI integration are host-platform or third-party tooling, so they are not credited as a Pinecone CLI. Missing for 10: a named, documented official Pinecone CLI, its command reference and install instructions, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Monitor performance, explore your data, and manage indexes from a clean, fast console — or stay in the terminal. Your call.
